Antecedentes Clínicos:
Obs. Lesión OC.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colateral lateral sin alteraciones. Leve engrosamiento secuelar del tercio
proximal del componente superficial del ligamento colateral medial. El resto de los componentes
del complejo medial sin alteraciones.
Aumento de señal central del cuerno posterior del menisco medial que no impresiona contactar
con la superficie articular, sin caracteres propios de rotura.
El menisco lateral es de morfología y señal conservada, sin signos de rotura.
Cartílagos de los compartimentos femorotibiales sin alteraciones. Úlceras condrales de espesor
total con cambios óseos secundarios de la región central y vertiente medial de la tróclea femoral.
Fina úlcera condral focal de espesor total de la faceta medial de la rótula.
Mínimo derrame articular con discreta sinovitis.
Aumento de señal de la inserción distal del tendón cuadricipital, sin signos de rotura. Discreto
edema del paquete adiposo retro cuadricipital suprarrotuliano. Aumento de señal del tercio
proximal del tendón rotuliano, sin signos de rotura.
Tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites normales.
Trofismo muscular conservado.
Impresión:
Leve engrosamiento secuelar del componente superficial del ligamento colateral medial.
Condropatía lesiones grado 4 de la tróclea femoral y grado 3, focal de la rótula.
Mínimo derrame articular con discreta sinovitis.
Leve tendinosis cuadricipital distal con discreto edema el paquete adiposo retro cuadricipital
suprarrotuliano. Leve tendinosis rotuliana proxima

Prikazane koštane strukture primjerenih intenziteta signala i morfologije.
Prikazana zglobna tijela primjereno su uzglobljena.
Promijenjen intenzitet signala artikulacijskih hrskavica medijalne fasete FT zgloba -
hondromalacija I/II°. Povišen intenzitet signala tijela i stražnjeg roga medijalnog meniska u
smislu degenerativnih promjena uz manju horizontalnu rupturu u području crvene zone stražnjeg
roga te diskretnu ekstruziju meniska. Blaže distendiran medijalni kolateralni ligament uz manji
periligamentarni edem, održanog kontinuiteta.
Lateralni menisk je bez znakova rupture ili degeneracije. Artikulacijske hrskavice lateralne fasete
FT zgloba su primjerenih intenziteta signala. Lateralni kolateralni ligament je primjerenih
intenziteta signala, održanog kontinuiteta.
Prednji križni ligament održanog kontinuiteta, u distalnom dijelu promijenjenih intenziteta signala
uz vidljivu ganglion cistu promjera 3 mm - nalaz može odgovarati degenerativnim promjenama ili
stanju nakon ranije parcijalne rupture.
Stražnji križni ligament je primjerenih intenziteta signala i održanog kontinuiteta.
Hondromalacija I° medijalne fasete patele.
Patelarni retinakulumi održani.
Uredan prikaz tetive popliteusa, iliotibijalnog trakta i pes anserinus.
Tetiva kvadricepsa i patelarni ligament su primjerenih intenziteta signala, održanog kontinuiteta.
Bez signifikantnog izljeva u zglob.
Ne nalazi se znakova poplitealne ciste.
Posteriorno uz lateralni kondil femura, uz stražnji križni ligament, nalazi se ganglion cista
sagitalno veličine 10 x 5 mm s centralnim hipointenzitetom koji može odgovarati kalcifikatu.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: 5 years of anterior knee pain
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: Partial-thickness chondral fissuring in the posterior nonweightbearing aspect of the medial femoral condyle.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Focal full-thickness fissuring in the and medial patellar facet with subchondral edema.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Mild increased signal proximally which may represent early degenerative change versus chronic resolving low-grade injury. 
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear. Edema and thickening of the quadriceps fat pad which may be secondary to impingement.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 12 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle. Mild prepatellar edema.

IMPRESSION:
Possible quadriceps tendon impingement with subsequent full-thickness chondral fissuring of the medial patellar facet with subchondral edema.

CLINICAL HISTORY:Right knee pain, suspected meniscal pathology.

PROCEDURE:Multisequence, multiplanar unenhanced MRI of the right knee according to routine protocol.

IMAGING FINDINGS:

Nondiagnostic scout localizing images reviewed.

Slight peripheral extrusion of the medial meniscal body without evidence of discrete medial meniscal tear.

The lateral meniscus is intact.

Intact anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament.

The medial collateral ligament, posterior oblique ligament, fibular collateral ligament, popliteus and biceps femoris tendon attachments, as well as iliotibial band are intact.

The patellar retinacula are intact. No femoral trochlear dysplasia. The TT-TG distance measures 8 mm, within normal limits. The quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact.

Scattered foci of mild chondrosis throughout the patellofemoral compartment. Preserved medial and lateral femorotibial articular cartilage.

Small knee joint effusion. Of note, there is an ovoid intramuscular lesion of low proton density/low T2 signal within the substance of the proximal fibers of the extensor digitorum muscle, measuring 33 mm craniocaudal, 15 mm anterior to posterior, 18 mm medial to lateral. The lesion shows a thin T2 hyperintense rim. This was not present on the recent prior MRI. The correlative plain films from [Date] show no evidence of focal mineralization in the region of the lesion.

Subcutaneous edema along the anterolateral aspect of the knee and proximal calf. No suspicious focal marrow signal alteration.

IMPRESSION:
1. Interval development of a 33 x 15 x 18 mm intramuscular lesion within the proximal musculature of the anterior compartment of the right calf. Correlation with gadolinium-enhanced MRI recommended for complete assessment.
2. Mild patellofemoral chondrosis.

CLINICAL HISTORY:Progressive right knee pain in the region of the medial meniscus, suspected medial meniscal tear.

PROCEDURE:Multisequence, multiplanar unenhanced MRI of the right knee according to routine protocol.

IMAGING FINDINGS:

Nondiagnostic scout localizing images reviewed.

Result cleavage tear extends through the posterior horn of the medial meniscus into the body, without medial meniscal extrusion. Multilobulated meniscal cyst adjacent to the posterior horn, measuring 9 x 5 x 4 mm. The posterior root is intact. The anterior horn is intact.

The lateral meniscus is intact.

Intact anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament.

The medial collateral ligament and posterior oblique ligament are intact. The fibular collateral ligament is intact. Popliteus and biceps femoris tendon attachments are intact. Iliotibial band is intact.

The patellar retinacula are intact. No femoral trochlear dysplasia. The TT-TG distance measures 8 mm, within normal limits. The quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact.

Mild patellofemoral chondrosis. Mild to moderate medial femorotibial chondrosis. The lateral femorotibial articular cartilage is preserved.

Trace knee joint fluid. Regional musculature is within normal limits. No suspicious focal marrow signal alteration. No erosions or periostitis. No synovitis or tenosynovitis.

IMPRESSION:
1. Horizontal cleavage tear posterior horn and body of the medial meniscus though medial meniscal extrusion. Parameniscal cyst formation adjacent to the posterior horn.
2. Nonspecific chondrosis medial and patellofemoral compartments, compatible with mild osteoarthritis most pronounced involving the medial femorotibial compartment. No specific imaging features of inflammatory arthritis.
